args.reason: The old decision's own rationale was a small run set (<20 issues) and simple atomic writes. The new argument shows both premises have changed: runs now admit 200+ issues and the concurrency executor writes many issues in parallel, which a single flat file serialises through one lock. Per-issue files bound a corrupt write to one issue and remove the contention. The change keeps the same directory root and adds an index file for discovery, so the supersession argument holds.
